rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING SURVIVORSHIP BENEFITS TO THE DEPENDENT CHILDREN OF A DECEASED RETIRED MEMBER OF THE COMMISSION ON AUDIT, CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION, COMMISSION ON ELECTIONS, AND THE OMBUDSMAN, WHO IS A SOLO PARENT, OR THE SURVIVING PARENTS OR NOMINATED PERSONS OF SUCH DECEASED RETIREE, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 10084, ENTITLED, \"AN ACT GRANTING SURVIVORSHIP BENEFITS TO THE SURVIVING LEGITIMATE SPOUSE OF A DECEASED RETIRED MEMBER OF THE COMMISSION ON AUDIT, CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION, COMMISSION ON ELECTIONS AND THE OMBUDSMAN, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES\"
rows.title_short: Granting Survivorship Benefits To The Dependent Children Of A Deceased Retired Member Of The Commission On Audit, Civil Service Commission, Commission On Elections, And The Ombudsman, Who Is A Solo Parent, Or The Surviving Parents Or Nominated Persons Of Such Deceased Retiree, Amending For The Purpose Republic Act No. 10084
rows.abstract:
Amends RA No. 10084 by granting survivorship benefits to dependents of retired members of the COA, CSC, COMELEC, and the Ombudsman, who are solo parents, to be awarded in the following order:
a. Dependent children or other children under the care of the deceased retiree as stipulated under RA 9262, (Anti-Violence Against Women and Their Children Act of 2004), including children who have reached the age of majority but are unable to fully take care of themselves or protect themselves from abuse, neglect, cruelty, exploitation, or discrimination because of a physical or mental disability or condition as defined under RA 7610 (Special Protection of Children Against Abuse, Exploitation and Discrimination Act).
b. The surviving parents, if any, or any person or persons nominated by the Chairman, Commissioner, or the Ombudsman prior to or on the date of retirement provided, that the nominees shall be limited to two (2) persons only. Beneficiaries who are receiving benefits under existing retirement laws shall only be entitled to the difference between the amount to be received pursuant to this Act and the retirement benefits being received.
rows.status: Vetoed by the President on2019-04-12

rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING INCENTIVES TO FILIPINO FILMMAKERS WHO WERE GRANTED HONORS IN NOTABLE INTERNATIONAL FILM FESTIVALS AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.title_short: Granting Incentives To Filipino Filmmakers Who Were Granted Honors In Notable International Film Festivals
rows.abstract:
Grants incentives to Filipino filmmakers or production entities, whose films merited the highest recognition for technical or artistic excellence in notable film festivals the following amount, to wit:
a) Five million pesos (Php5,000,000.00) to the filmmaker or production entity that produces the international award winning full-length feature or documentary film; b) Three million pesos (Php 3,000,000.00) to the filmmaker or production entity that produces the international award-winning short feature or documentary film; c)Two million pesos (Php 2,000,000.00) to film directors, main artists, screenplay, or technical support filmmaker personnel including the scriptwriter , cinematographer, editor, production designer, music scoring, sound editor, audio or video technicians who have received the highest international awards in their respective categories; d) One million pesos (Php1,000,000.00) to supporting artists or technicians who have garnered the highest award in their respective categories; and e) An “A” rating from the Cinema Evaluation Board  for international award-winning films as stated in paragraphs (a) and (b) of Section 3.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2018-11-12, transmitted to the Senate on 2018-11-13 and received by the Senate on 2018-11-13

rows.title_full: AN ACT DEFINING THE CRIME OF BETRAYAL OF DUTY IN THE CUSTODY OF PRISONERS PROVIDING FOR ADDITIONAL RULES ON THE IMPRISONMENT, DETENTION, CONFINEMENT AND CUSTODY OF PRISONERS AND DETAINEES, SPECIFYING ADDITIONAL WORK AND RESPONSIBILITIES OF GOVERNMENT PERSONNEL CHARGED WITH THE CUSTODY OF SUCH PRISONERS AND STATING THE PENALTIES THEREFORE, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES

rows.title_full: AN ACT INCREASING THE YEARLY ALLOCATION FOR SCIENTIFIC AND TECHNOLOGICAL ACTIVITIES (STA) AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Seeks to allocate 1% of Gross Domestic Product (GDP) as annual budget for science and technology activities (STA) for generation, advancement, dissemination, and application of scientific knowledge in all fields of Science and Technology; Creates a special fund for research and development to be known as “R&D” from the following sources: a. allocation of 1 percent (1%) of GDP for S&T activities; b. all unused R&D allocation; and c. all income derived from R&D activities

rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTIONALIZING THE TREATMENT OF ACTIVE MILITARY PERSONNEL WITH POST-TRAUMATIC STRESS DISORDER AND PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Recognizes the relevance of the advent of increasing awareness on the issue of mental health as it relates to the country´s Armed Forces; Aims to institutionalize the treatment and prevention of post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) for the benefit of the country´s Armed Forces.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on NATIONAL DEFENSE AND SECURITY since 2018-07-30

rows.author: H064;
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING A MECHANISM FOR GENERATING QUALITY GRADUATES OF HIGHER EDUCATION INSTITUTIONS BASED ON PERFORMANCE IN PROFESSIONAL LICENSURE EXAMINATIONS
rows.abstract: Provides for the continued government accreditation of professional degree courses of higher education institutions based on the performance of their graduates in professional boards and bar examinations; Proposes to permanently revoke government recognition and/or permit to operate pertinent and related professional courses whose graduates registered zero-performance in three (3) out of five (5) consecutive times they participated; Requires the publication of results in nationally circulated newspapers showing the percentage of successful examinees.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HIGHER AND TECHNICAL EDUCATION since 2018-07-30

rows.author: H064;
rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTIONALIZING PRE-SCHOOL EDUCATION, INCREASING THE MONTHLY COMPENSATION OF DAY CARE WORKERS AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Institutionalizes pre-school education as part of the compulsory basic education and provides that Barangay Day Care Centers (R.A. 6972) constitute said public sector institution; Mandates pre-school teachers to continuously undergo the necessary trainings and provides for their monthly basic salary based on the compensation of public school teachers under the SSL, as amended; Enumerates the functions of the DSWD and qualifications and appointment of day care workers.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2018-07-30

rows.author: H064;
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO ENCOURAGE AND FACILITATE INFORMATION SHARING BETWEEN THE AGENCIES OF THE PHILIPPINE GOVERNMENT IN ORDER TO PROTECT THE PHILIPPINES AGAINST ACTIVITIES THAT UNDERMINE ITS SECURITY
rows.abstract: Recognizes that information needs to be shared - and - disparate ones need to be efficiently collated to enable the Government to protect the Philippines from activities that undermines its sovereignty, security or territorial integrity or the lives and security of the Filipino people; Enumerates guiding principles for information sharing under this Act, the activities that poses a threat to the security of the country, and the powers of the Director-General of the National Intelligence Coordinating Agency.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC ORDER AND SAFETY since 2018-07-30

rows.author: H064;
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE MUNICIPAL AGRICULTURE INFORMATION SYSTEM

rows.alias_name: “ Municipal Agriculture Information System Act ( M A I S Act) ”
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on AGRICULTURE AND FOOD since 2018-07-30

rows.author: H064;
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROMOTING SOCIO-ECONOMIC ACTIVITY AND REGIONAL CONNECTIVITY BY RATIONALIZING THE LOCAL ROAD NETWORK SYSTEM

rows.author: H064;

rows.abstract: Aims to respond to the need for the public to be appraised as to whether or not the fees that foreign consultants receive corresponds to the quality of service they render; Assigns the office of the Executive Secretary to maintain a centralized data-file of all foreign consultants hired or retained by the Government and to publish such list in at least two newspapers of general circulation.

rows.abstract: Aims to rationalize the government´s school building strategy to effectively address the insufficiency of school infrastructures by enforcing a five-year comprehensive and consistent program; Features the provision of build, operate and transfer, build and transfer, build-lease and transfer, rehabilitate-operate and transfer and other contractual arrangement schemes provided under Republic Act No. 6957 to finance the said construction.

rows.author: H064;
rows.title_full: AN ACT RATIONALIZING EXTRADITION PROCEEDINGS AMENDING FOR THIS PURPOSE PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 1069, ALSO KNOWN AS THE \"PHILIPPINE EXTRADITION LAW\"
rows.abstract:
Amends Sec.2, par.(a) of PD 1069 to read as follows:
(a)	“Extradition” - The TURN-OVER OF THE EXTRADITABLE PERSON/S, PURSUANT TO A TREATY, TO THE DESIGNATED AUTHORITES OF THE REQUESTING STATE, with the object of placing him at the disposal of the requesting state or government to hold hIm in connection with any criminal investigation directed against him or the execution of a penalty imposed on him under the penal or criminal laws of the requesting state or government; Provides for just and  appropriate extradition proceedings for both the accused alien and a resident citizen of the Philippines; Guarantees due process in the seizure and turn over of accused properties by determining the relevance thereof to the charges for which the accused is sought to be extradited,
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2018-07-30

rows.author: H064;

rows.abstract: Aims to reduce road accidents and improve the overall safety and convenience of our motorists by banning the use or installation of high intensity discharge “xenon headlights/headlamps”; Imposes a fine of one hundred thousand (P100,000.00) for every sale of a motor vehicle fitted with such prohibited headlamps and a fine of ten thousand pesos (P10,000.00) for every violation by the owner and driver of a motor vehicle.

rows.title_full: AN ACT TO PROVIDE YOUTH SUICIDE INTERVENTION AND PREVENTION
rows.abstract: Mandates the Department of Education (DepEd), in coordination with the Department of Health (DOH), to formulate and include a course of Life Planning in the elementary and secondary education curriculum which shall require lectures and discussion on self and identity; personal, family, community values; communication and interrelationship with others; sexuality and gender roles; community participation; health; psychological thinking and employment, among others.  It requires all schools to implement a Peer Counselling Program that includes the Peer Counselling Training Course and the Mentor-Mentee Program. rows.author: I051;
rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTING THE FARMERS AND FISHERFOLK ENTERPRISE DEVELOPMENT PROGRAM OF THE DEPARTMENT OF AGRICULTURE AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Establishes the Farmers and Fisherfolk Enterprise Development Program which shall refer to the comprehensive set of objectives, targets, and holistic approach and assistance in promoting the establishment of enterprises involving agricultural and fishery products. It shall be integrated and be made consistent with the Agriculture and Fisheries Modernization Plan, and the Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises Development Plan.
The Program shall cover the following areas: a) Agricultural and fisheries production; b)Acquisition of work animals, farm and fishery equipment and machinery; c) Acquisition of seeds, fertilizer, poultry, livestock, feeds, and other similar items; d) Procurement of agricultural and fisheries products for storage, trading, processing, and distribution; e) Construction, acquisition, and repair of facilities for production, processing, storage, transportation, communication, marketing, and such other facilities in support of agriculture and fisheries; f) Working capital for agriculture and fisheries graduates to enable them to engage in agriculture and fisheries related economic activities; g) Agribusiness activities which support soil and water conservation and ecology enhancing activities; h) Working capital for long gestating projects; and i) Credit guarantees on uncollateralized loans to farmers and fisherfolk.
rows.status: Substituted by HB08857

rows.abstract: Seeks to create the Philippine Center for Diabetes and Endocrinology (PCDE) which shall serve as the lead tertiary-level center in the screening, prevention, diagnosis and treatment of diabetes. Grants PCDE the authority to call upon any department, bureau, office, agency, or instrumentality of the government, including government-owned or controlled corporations, local government units, and state universities and colleges for such assistance as it may need in the pursuit of its purposes and objectives. Appropriates the amount of Ten Billion Pesos (Php10,000,000,000.00) from the Philippine Amusement and Gaming Corporation (PAGCOR) to defray the initial operation and maintenance of the PCDE to be included in the General Appropriations Act.

rows.author: H061;
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A MAGNA CARTA OF WORKERS IN INFORMAL ECONOMY INSTITUTIONALIZING MECHANISMS FOR IMPLEMENTATION THEREOF AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Provides a comprehensive, rights-based, participatory, sustainable and gender responsive frameworks in the informal economy. Defines certain terms as used in this Act such as: a) Informal Economy - refers to “all economic activities by workers and economic units that are - in law or in practice not covered or insufficiency covered by formal arrangements.” b) Informal Sector - refers to units engaged in the production of goods and services with the primary objective of generating employment and incomes to the persons concerned. It consists of households and unincorporated enterprises that are market and nonmarket producers of goods, as well as market producers of services; among others.  
Provides the coverage, qualifications and accreditation, as well as, the right and benefits of Workers in the Informal Economy (WIE). Creates the Informal Economy Development Council (IEDC) which shall be an agency within the Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) that shall institute appropriate reforms within its structure, programming and other processes, including adjusting its human resource capabilities to ensure that WIE-focused programs will be efficiently and adequately implemented to address the needs of these workers.
rows.alias_name: “Magna Carta of Workers in the Informal Economy.”

rows.author: H061;
rows.title_full: AN ACT IMPOSING A SIX-YEAR MORATORIUM ON THE INCREASE OF ALL GOVERNMENT FEES AND CHARGES
rows.abstract: Aims to suspend all increases for fees and charges for all services imposed by the national and local government for a period of six (6) years.
rows.alias_name: “Iwas Dagdag Singil sa Serbisyo ng Gobyerno Act.”
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WAYS AND MEANS since 2018-07-30

rows.author: H061;
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE NATIONAL TRAFFIC ENFORCEMENT AND MANAGEMENT CENTER, DEFINING ITS POWERS, FUNCTIONS AND DUTIES, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Seeks to establish a National Traffic Enforcement and Management Center that shall be responsible to build the capacity of traffic enforcers, assess the capability of traffic enforcement and management of personnel of the various Local Government Units (LGUs), research on the causes and consequences of road accidents and such other functions related to road traffic enforcement, education and management.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on GOVERNMENT REORGANIZATION since 2018-07-30

rows.author: H061;
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE PHILIPPINE CANCER CENTER, PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Seeks to create and establish a specialized cancer center known as “Philippine Cancer Center” that shall promote and engage in scientific research for the prevention of cancer and the care and/or treatment of cancer patients; facilitate and encourage the exchange of ideas and information on the prevention, treatment and control of cancer; and develop public interest on cancer awareness and general health.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on GOVERNMENT REORGANIZATION since 2018-07-30

rows.author: H061;
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO ENHANCE CITIZENS' ACCESS TO GOVERNMENT INFORMATION AND SERVICES BY ESTABLISHING A SYSTEM IN WHICH GOVERNMENT DOCUMENTS ISSUED TO THE PUBLIC MUST BE WRITTEN IN PLAIN LANGUAGE AND TRANSLATED TO THE LOCAL LANGUAGE OR DIALECTS IF NECESSARY, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Mandates all government agencies and local government units to adopt plain language in all their communications and in implementing basic functions, mandates and services and to translate said communications and implementation to the predominant language or dialect that a particular locality or group of people use.
rows.alias_name: “Plain Writing for Public Service Act of 2016.”
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC INFORMATION since 2018-07-30

rows.author: H061;
rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING BENEFITS AND PRIVILEGES TO FORMER PRESIDENTS AND VICE PRESIDENTS OF THE PHILIPPINES OR THEIR SURVIVING SPOUSES, AMENDING FOR THIS PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 5059, REPEALING REPUBLIC ACT NO. 2087, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Grants former Presidents and Vice Presidents the following benefits and privileges: a.) tax-free retirement pension equivalent to the salary of an incumbent President and Vice President, respectively; b.) personal security and protection detail of at least three (3) personnel to be provided by the PSG; c.) Franking privileges; and d.) fifty percent (50%) discount on all public transportation and foreign travel. The same shall be extended to the surviving spouse provided he/she will not re-marry.
rows.alias_name: “Former Presidents and Vice Presidents´ Benefits Act of 2018.”
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on APPROPRIATIONS since 2018-07-30

rows.author: H061;
rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING ALL PUBLIC ELEMENTARY AND SECONDARY SCHOOLS TO PREPARE AND IMPLEMENT A LAND USE DEVELOPMENT AND INFRASTRUCTURE PLAN FOR THE OPTIMUM UTILIZATION  OF ITS RESOURCES IN ADDRESSING BASIC EDUCATION FACILITY SHORTAGES
rows.abstract: Mandates all public schools to prepare and implement a land use development and infrastructure plan which will contribute to a more conducive teaching-learning and recreation area for the students and faculty for the holistic development of learners.  Requires that infrastructure and physical facility requirements must comply with the prevailing disaster risk reduction and mitigation measures.
rows.alias_name: “Public School Site Development and Infrastructure Plan Act of 2016.”
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2018-07-30

rows.author: I108;F036;G064;
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE ESTABLISHMENT OF A MANPOWER LIVELIHOOD AND SKILLS DEVELOPMENT CENTER IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF DAPA, SIARGAO ISLAND, PROVINCE OF SURIGAO DEL NORTE TO BE KNOWN AS THE SIARGAO SURIGAO DEL NORTE TESDA TRAINING CENTER, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.title_short: Providing For The Establishment Of A Manpower Livelihood And Skills Development Center In The Municipality Of Dapa, Siargao Island, Province Of Surigao Del Norte To Be Known As The Siargao Surigao Del Norte Tesda Training Center
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2018-08-29, transmitted to the Senate on 2018-08-30 and received by the Senate on 2018-08-30

rows.author: G101;
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING GUIDELINES FOR THE APPLICATION OF LOCAL CHARGES (ORIGIN AND DESTINATION FEES) IMPOSED BY INTERNATIONAL SHIPPING LINES TO COMPLY WITH EXISTING LAWS AND INTERNATIONAL STANDARDS (INCO TERMS)
rows.abstract: Seeks to a.) enforce applicable Philippine Law; b.) collect the correct rate of duties and taxes on importations by transparently including the cost of transportation on the dutiable value of the importations; c.) collect the taxes due on revenue generated by international shipping lines for activities and corresponding income generated within the Philippines in accordance with the pertinent provisions of the Internal Revenue Code; d.) make sure that business is conducted based on internationally recognized standards agreed by the contracting trade partners; and, e.) protect the public from arbitrary, compulsive and indiscriminate charges incorrectly collected from the parties not subject of any contract under duress.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRANSPORTATION since 2018-07-30

rows.author: I028;
rows.title_full: AN ACT EXPANDING AND UPGRADING THE SERVICES OF THE MARIVELES MENTAL HOSPITAL IN MARIVELES, BATAAN, TO INCLUDE THE OPERATION OF A LEVEL 1 GENERAL WARD WITH 100 BED CAPACITY, RENAMING THE SAME AS MARIVELES HEALTH AND WELLNESS INSTITUTE, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.status: Substituted by HB08449

rows.author: I028;
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE ESTABLISHMENT OF LEARNING CITIES, MANDATING COMPLIANCE WITH THE KEY FEATURES THEREOF AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Declares that “the State shall promote lifelong learning as a tool for a more sustainable and secure nation by prescribing basic standards concerning the duties of the State and local government units for the promotion of lifelong education.” Requires heads of LGUs designated as Learning Cities to guide and support activities for the promotion of lifelong education whether initiated by the LGU or private lifelong educational institutions and to conduct training necessary to upgrade the capabilities of persons and institutions engaged in lifelong education activities.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2018-07-30

rows.author: H046;
rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING THE ESTABLISHMENT OF FULLY-EQUIPPED SCIENCE LABORATORIES IN EVERY PUBLIC ELEMENTARY AND SECONDARY SCHOOL AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Aims to improve the quality of Science and Technology education in the country through adoption of modern methods of teaching Science and Technology (S&T) in elementary and high school and provide learners with laboratory equipment and facilities.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2018-07-30

rows.author: G052;
rows.title_full: AN ACT TRANSFERRING SELECTED NATIONAL GOVERNMENT AGENCIES AND GOVERNMENT-OWNED AND -CONTROLLED CORPORATIONS TO NEW CLARK CITY, PAMPANGA
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on GOVERNMENT REORGANIZATION since 2018-07-30

rows.author: H046;
rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING PHILIPPINE CITIZENSHIP TO REVEREND FATHER LUCIANO ARIEL FELLONI
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2018-07-30

rows.author: G099;
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE IMPOSITION OF INTEREST AND/OR PENALTY CHARGES ON UNPAID HOSPITAL BILLS AND MEDICAL EXPENSES OF PATIENTS WHO EARN MINIMUM WAGE OR LESS
rows.abstract: Penalizes any officer or employee of the hospital or medical clinic responsible for billing who violates the provision of this Act with a fine of not less than Twenty Thousand Pesos (Php20,000.00) but not more than Fifty Thousand Pesos (Php50,000.00), or imprisonment of not less than one (1) month but not more than six (6) months, or both such fine and imprisonment, at the discretion of the proper court.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2018-07-30

rows.author: G099;
rows.title_full: AN ACT MANDATING ALL EMPLOYERS IN THE PRIVATE AND PUBLIC SECTORS, INCLUDING ALL GOVERNMENT OFFICES, AGENCIES AND INSTRUMENTALITIES, TO PROVIDE, FREE OF CHARGE, CLEAN, HEALTHY, SUFFICIENT AND ACCESSIBLE DRINKING WATER TO ALL ITS  EMPLOYEES
rows.abstract: Mandates employers in the private and public sectors to provide all employees with clean, healthy, sufficient and accessible drinking water during working hours while performing their respective tasks and/or duties inside or outside the office or business place and premises not in the form of monetary allowance of whatever nature and not to be deducted the expenses for said item in the salaries, allowances and/or benefits of/for the employees.
rows.alias_name: “Tubig para sa mga Empleyado Act of 2018.”
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 2018-07-30

rows.author: I089;
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 82 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 10963, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE TAX REFORM FOR ACCELERATION AND INCLUSION ACT, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Aims to increase the unconditional cash transfer to Five Hundred Pesos (P500.00) which may be increased, as may be necessary by the President of the Philippines, upon unanimous recommendation of the Secretaries of Finance, Social Welfare and Development, and Budget and Management.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WAYS AND MEANS since 2018-07-30

rows.title_short: Declaring The Province Of North Cotabato A Mining- Free Zone And Providing Penalties For The Violation Thereof
